messages:
Ben Hart: Hey team, received AtlasGrid invoice INV-2026-12-402 for $4,250. It references PO-ENG-2026-078 but approver routing sent it to Sales instead of VP Eng. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/atlasgrid-inv-402.pdf :confused:

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: AtlasGrid INV-2026-12-402, vendor_id=AG-212, amount $4,250. Detected PO: PO-ENG-2026-078 (status: active). Routing mismatch: approver group=Sales. Recommended: HOLD and correct approver routing. AP ticket AP-9003 created.

Sofia Lin: That PO is definitely ENG-Platform. Procurement mapping for PO-ENG-* should route to VP Eng (Anika) for amounts > $2,500. Looks like vendor sent wrong billing contact info.

Marcus Yoon: If AP auto-matched PO but routed wrong, we need to fix vendor master data for AtlasGrid (billing_contact, approver_group). Also check if any payments slipped through for prior invoices.

approvals-bot: AP-9003 update: routed_to=Sales -> action_required: re-route to finance-approvals (VP Eng). Suggested steps: 1) AP to correct vendor contact record; 2) Procurement to confirm PO mapping; 3) If payment already issued, process reversal and reissue.

Ben Hart: I've flagged AP to HOLD payment. Ben -> AP: "Do not release payment. Please correct approver to VP Eng and confirm AP will not pay until routing fixed."

Sofia Lin: I'll open a vendor master change request. Vendor portal shows billing_contact=accounts@atlasgrid.com and approver_group=SalesBilling. We'll change to approver_group=EngFinance and contact to ap-eng@atlasgrid.com. Procurement ticket PR-4472 opened.

Marcus Yoon: Also attach the PO crosswalk and the project usage: `s3://redwood-logs/invoice-crosswalk/atlasgrid/2026-12/12-04-crosswalk.csv`. If AP finds a prior paid invoice with the same issue, we may need a reversal.

invoices-bot: AP-9003 note: vendor_contacted. Vendor confirmed billing_contact update request received. They can reissue invoice referencing the same PO and will wait 5 business days. Added note: "If AP already paid, vendor will accept reversal + corrected invoice."

Ben Hart: If vendor reissues, AP can process normally. If AP already paid, we need a reversal flow: Accounts will raise AR reversal request and route to Legal if vendor resists.

Sofia Lin: Update: vendor reissued invoice now with correct contact and same PO. New PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/atlasgrid-inv-402-v2.pdf

Marcus Yoon: Great. AP, please confirm you see INV-402-v2 and that approver routing goes to Anika. If all clear, we can close AP-9003.

invoices-bot: AP-9003 state: vendor_reissued -> approver_routed_to=VP Eng. Pending AP confirmation for payment release.

Ben Hart: Confirmed: approver now Anika (VP Eng). I'll ping Anika for quick approval. If approved, AP can release payment coded to ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602).

Sofia Lin: Procurement updated vendor master. Note added to vendor record: "Ensure billing_contact=ap-eng@atlasgrid.com; approver_group=EngFinance; Do not route to Sales." PR-4472 resolved.

Ben Hart: Closing thread once AP marks invoice paid. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
